statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness
There is concern for an underlying arrhythmia
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
The service is to evaluate for potential cardioembolic sources or symptomatic dysrhythmias
CPT code 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring) was billed
Diagnosis codes Z86.73, R00.2, and R42 were submitted
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to the service date
